performance.method: one continuous performance: a seed take extended only by audio continuation under one invariant prompt; direct splices, weighed
performance.invariant_prompt: detroit bounce hip hop instrumental in F minor, energetic bouncing groove, deep rolling 808 bass, crisp drums with a live played feel, a virtuoso violin playing fast Paganini-style arpeggios dancing over the groove throughout, eerie minor-key piano motif, warm soulful strings, dusty vinyl warmth, one continuous live performance that keeps developing

warmup.note: the warm-up was struck to be discarded: the kept program opens where the performance's clock had locked. Its tempo stands measured here so the discard is evidence, not hope.

join_summary.splice: direct -- no crossfade, no gain, no trim

realized_tempo.estimator: onset envelope (spectral flux) autocorrelation with a log-Gaussian tempo prior (center 100 BPM, sigma 1 octave), 40..200 BPM search on the performance's mid channel; the dominant periodicity and the candidate table stand beside the headline so the prior's work is visible

absent_by_design: sigma layer (test purity; acquitted by the v4b A/B)
kit / one-shot samples of any kind
per-section prompts, motif resets, section names in generation
composed arpeggio layer (the Paganini line is generated INSIDE the performance, per the founder's ruling: if it isn't in the performance, it isn't in the track)

sigma.engine: excluded for test purity (founder's order); acquitted by the v4b A/B

notes: performance: ONE invariant prompt, struck once as a seed take and extended only by audio continuation -- the model plays through every join. The takes are spliced DIRECTLY: no crossfade, no per-take RMS matching (there are no sections to match), no grid, no trim, no tempo surgery of any kind.

absent by design: the Sigma binaural layer (excluded for test purity at the founder's order -- the v4b A/B acquitted it; its absence here is hygiene, not suspicion), any spine, any kit or sample, any synthesized voice, any second prompt.

tempo: the performance chose its own clock. The prompt asked for energy and bounce, never a number; realized tempo stands measured -- globally and per 30 s window -- in the performance block. Drift is reported, not corrected.
the performance itself is not transcribed in composition.abc: its transcription is a separate production, owed and marked owed -- never fabricated.
loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the proof build, stated not hidden).
2 s tail fade + 5 ms head fade applied before mastering.

nothing rides: there is NO composed arpeggio layer in this run. The Paganini line stands in the prompt itself, and the performance played its own violin arpeggios as part of its body -- in tune, in phrase, or not at all; the ear will judge what the prompt bought. composition.abc notates nothing and marks the performance's transcription owed.

single session: the whole chain was born in ONE bridge process; every continuation was conditioned on the bridge's in-memory predecessor; no take was resumed from disk, and the session guard verified the chain before the splice. No prior attempt stood on the ground to void.

warm-up: 1 leading take(s) (29.94 s) were struck and DISCARDED -- their audio is nowhere in the program. The warm-up's own measured tempo was 96.57 BPM; the kept program's windows stand in the performance block for the lock-in question.
